error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code.
key_rule: key package observes the dpkg Status of package auditd; key service observes systemd unit auditd.service
package_rule: dpkg-query -W -f=${Status} auditd with LC_ALL=C; exit code 1 with empty stdout is VALUE not-installed FAIL; stdout must be three space-separated fields want (unknown, install, hold, deinstall, purge), eflag (ok, reinstreq) and status (not-installed, config-files, half-installed, unpacked, half-configured, triggers-awaited, triggers-pending, installed); install ok installed is VALUE installed PASS; status not-installed is VALUE not-installed FAIL; any other valid Status is VALUE with that Status, FAIL; another exit code, a launch failure or any field outside these lists is ERROR
service_rule: systemctl show --property=LoadState,ActiveState,UnitFileState -- auditd.service; each property exactly once; LoadState in loaded, not-found, masked, bad-setting, error, merged, stub; ActiveState in active, reloading, inactive, failed, activating, deactivating, maintenance, refreshing; UnitFileState in enabled, enabled-runtime, linked, linked-runtime, alias, masked, masked-runtime, static, indirect, disabled, generated, transient, bad, or empty only with LoadState not-found; any other value, a failed query or missing, duplicate or unknown properties is ERROR; PASS only when LoadState=loaded, UnitFileState=enabled and ActiveState=active, VALUE <UnitFileState>/<ActiveState>; not-found is VALUE not-found FAIL; masked is VALUE masked/<ActiveState> FAIL; bad-setting, error, merged and stub are ERROR systemd:unit-load-<LoadState>
source_rule: fstec-logging-2025 appendix 2 item 1 requires installing auditd where it is absent and item 2 requires starting and enabling the service; by user decision 30.09.2026 (variant B, auditd segmentation map v5) package and service are one control each
value_rule: VALUE is installed, not-installed or the dpkg Status for key package; <UnitFileState>/<ActiveState>, not-found or masked/<ActiveState> for key service
